name: Defensive Response Expectation v1

E2b_additions: seven within-match defending-side by concurrent_attacker_path_m interactions
features.continuous_scaling: training-fold mean and population SD ddof=0
features.zero_variance_training_feature: drop identically from all models in that fold and record

coordinates.longitudinal_sign: positive in the attacking team's goalward direction using the governed period direction registry
coordinates.lateral: absolute offset; no left/right tactical semantics

primary.name: five-fold leave-contiguous-block-group-out within match
primary.fold_assignment: sort unique period/block keys within match and assign floor(5*i/B), capped at 4
primary.training: other four fold groups pooled across matches
primary.embargo: exclude training blocks immediately adjacent in the same period to each test interval

repeated_team.design: leave one match out; estimate the repeated-team intercept/path deviation on the other four matches and evaluate only that team's rows in the fifth

metrics.primary: equal-match macro heldout MAE in m/s

materiality.justification: matches the project's prior frozen adjacent-step materiality scale and prevents tiny capacity gains from being called substantive

uncertainty.resampling: resample matches, then heldout match-period 60-second blocks; preserve all anchor-linked rows

team_label_control.method: within each match-period, circularly shift defending-side labels by nonzero 60-second-block offsets; preserve anchors and simultaneous attackers
team_label_control.pass: observed E2b-vs-E1 relative improvement exceeds the 95th percentile of shuffled-label improvements

classification.INVALID: hard QC or fold validity failure, fewer than 1900 valid uncertainty replicates, any match below 1000 common rows, common-row retention below 90%, or rank-deficient frozen design
classification.NOT_SUPPORTED: valid E2b macro improvement versus E1 is at or below zero, or no more than three of seven match MAEs improve
classification.SUPPORTED: E2b improves at least six of seven matches, macro relative MAE improves at least 3%, the 95% paired absolute-error improvement interval is strictly above zero, and the shuffled-label control passes
classification.MIXED: every other valid result with positive macro improvement and at least four of seven improving matches

secondary_outputs: E1 residual distribution by match and defending side
absolute residual magnitude by match and defending side
D1 response minus D2_D3 mean description
